snapshot.name: ak:watzup
snapshot.description: Generate short handoff reports from Git branches, remote refs, worktrees, unfinished plans, and roadmap docs. Surfaces priority-ranked next steps with checkbox progress and rationale. Use when the user asks what's in flight, wants progress/next steps, is in a fresh worktree or detached checkout, or needs end-of-session status.
snapshot.when_to_use: Invoke for end-of-session handoffs, progress summaries, cross-branch worktree status, unfinished plan discovery, and next-step recommendations.
